proposal.reason: Main change is communicator-level configuration control: new config fields (nChannelsPerNetPeer, graphUsageMode, maxP2pPeers, nvlinkCentricSched), validation/defaults/env overrides, and rank-wide propagation in init/lifecycle paths. Add device-topology because src/graph/paths.cc substantively changes P2P channel computation and peer-budget tuning for network peers. Add enqueue because enqueue/strongstream logic now changes graph-capture mixing behavior and P2P task channel scheduling decisions at runtime.
